inputs.text: [serious] But the Earth moves! [pauses] Back when the first dinosaurs lived, everything was still stuck together in one piece. [softly] Then, little by little, over a very, very long time, the pieces drifted apart — [amazed] like two big rafts sliding far away from each other. A huge ocean opens up between them! [pauses] Dinosaurs on one side could no longer see the ones on the other.
[gasps] It broke apart all at once? Like, CRACK?

[softly] No, no, very, very slowly! [pauses] Over millions of years, it splits apart bit by bit. [calm] The continents drift like giant rafts floating farther and farther from each other. [amazed] And after a very long time, they end up right where they are today.
